fib: ______ is the median of the distribution.
value of X
The value of X is the median of the distribution.
______ is called a score or observation while a collection of pieces of data pertaining to a topic is called variable.
piece of data
A piece of data is called a score or observation while a collection of pieces of data pertaining to a topic is called variable.
______ is the degree to which numerical data tend to spread about an average value of the data.
dispersion or variation
The dispersion or variation is the degree to which numerical data tend to spread about an average value of the data.
______ is used to mean the totality of cases in an investigation.
Population or universe
Population or universe is used to mean the totality of cases in an investigation.
______ is a circular diagram with the circumference of 3600, in which each item is represented by a sector whose area is proportional to the percentage or relative frequency of the total.
pie chart
A pie chart is a circular diagram with the circumference of 3600, in which each item is represented by a sector whose area is proportional to the percentage or relative frequency of the total.
______ is the commonly used measure of dispersion of a set of observation.
Standard deviation
Standard deviation is the commonly used measure of dispersion of a set of observation.
______ are the smallest (lower class limit) and the largest (upper class limit) observation in each class.
class limits
The class limits are the smallest (lower class limit) and the largest (upper class limit) observation in each class.
______ is used to compare the significant difference in several means at the same time for the analysis of variance (ANOVA).
F distribution
F distribution is used to compare the significant difference in several means at the same time for the analysis of variance (ANOVA).
______ is a line graph joining the mid-point of the class interval.
frequency polygon
A frequency polygon is a line graph joining the mid-point of the class interval.
______ is a graphical display of frequency distribution in bars.
bar chart
Bar and Pie Charts A bar chart is a graphical display of frequency distribution in bars.
______ is used to determine the difference between expected and the observed results.
chi square distribution
A chi square distribution is used to determine the difference between expected and the observed results.
